text:
Zoe: Quick exec weekly - three rapid updates for the leadership team. Short version: EU Private GA is tentatively scheduled for next Thursday but we need two policy signoffs and an SRE go/no-go. Please ack.

Zoe: Topline numbers: p95 overall 220ms (up ~25ms WoW), token-unit cost +10% QoQ driven by longer-context reranking jobs, overall error-rate 0.6% with a small cluster-level spike last night.

Zoe: Immediate asks (owners):
• Approve temporary burst-capacity policy for EU region (Ravi) - this is a 48hr lift to cover initial ramp.
• Legal + Security signoff on adjusted eval log retention for Optimize (Mira + Alan) - proposal: 60d limited-access retention, scrubbed traces only.
• SRE automated fallback thresholds and canary cadence (Jo) - define triggers for traffic shift to hosted.

Zoe: If we don't have all green by Wed 18:00 UTC, GA moves by 72hrs. No exceptions unless exec approves.

Mira: Reviewing the retention language. Need confirmation that no raw customer payloads are stored in Optimize evals. Also want a brief note for customers about data handling.

Alan: Finance ask - what is expected monthly incremental cost for the burst window if kept as sustained reserve vs short-term preemptible? Need a 3-line sensitivity table by Tue EOD.

Ravi: Ops will implement the burst-cap policy. Quick summary: short-lived preemptible nodes + priority queueing + graceful drain. Proposed rollout: enable for 24hrs, monitor, extend to 48hrs if healthy. Will coordinate with Jo for fallbacks.

Jo: SRE ack. Proposed triggers: if error-rate >= 1% for 10m OR p95 >= 350ms for 15m, shift 40% traffic to hosted. Canary plan: 1% traffic for 2 hours, expand to 10% over 4 hours if stable. Adding dashboard alerts and runbook entries now.

deploy-bot: Scheduled release: eu-private/ga-candidate -> canary @ 1770064800 (Thu 08:00 UTC). CI status: unit+integration checks passed; perf smoke green.

Mira: Confirmed - Optimize evals will be scrubbed. I'll draft customer-facing blurb and share it in the shared drive.

Alan: Finance will produce the sensitivity table. Will post numbers by Tue 17:00 UTC.

Ravi: Ops will add the burst-policy config to the repo. Snippet below: 

```
# burst-policy v1 (ops temporary)
burst_enabled: true
burst_mode: preemptible
burst_window_hours: 48
priority_routing: true
autoscaler:
  min: 6
  max: 60
```

Jo: Adding runbook example command: `redwood route --set hosted --percent 40 --reason "eu-private-fallback"`

Zoe: Thanks. We'll do a short 20m check-in Wed 16:30 UTC to validate signoffs (calendar invite sent). If anything looks risky before then, ping me directly. Goal: safe and predictable GA with clear rollback paths. :sparkles: :rocket:

Ravi: Acknowledged.

Jo: Acknowledged, will post watch dashboard and Slack alert channel.

Mira: Acknowledged, drafting legal note.

Alan: Acknowledged, finance numbers incoming.

Zoe: Follow-up after Wed check-in with final decision. Thanks team.
